fields.description:
## Objective

Governed proof storage: Proof Files object with category metadata, an upload component on Sign-Up, a storage service writing to the selected platform, and proof-completion logic.

## Implementation Requirements

* Proof Files object + related list per design doc story H-01
* Upload component per H-02
* Storage service per H-03 using a service account (not per-rep OAuth)
* Proof/profile completion logic per H-04, wiring Sign-Up proof completion status

## Acceptance Criteria

* Per-story acceptance criteria in the design doc (H-01 through H-04)

## Testing Notes

Upload matrix including failure/retry paths.

## Out of Scope

Agency-site registration proof workflow (optional H-05). Automated archiving (client researching third-party tools).

## Open Questions

* Storage platform confirmation (GCP selected pending client's technical sign-off) — do not start the storage service until confirmed.
* Upload pattern: one Upload Proof button with per-file category, or three category-labelled buttons?
* Exact required proof set for a complete Sign-Up and how proofs weight completion %.
* Client compliance sign-off on storing KYC/PII proofs outside Salesforce.

## Additional Notes

* Client stands up the storage side (project, API enablement, service account, shared drive) and hands over credentials — client scope, track separately.

---

Estimate: XL · \~54h total · Dependencies: Storage platform decision (client, due this week) · Ticket BUILD-06 (approved 2026-07-04)

SCOPE UPDATE — 2026-07-28 (Additional User Stories reconciliation)

Progress already delivered (this ticket reads as fully blocked, which understates where we are):

* Sign_Up\__c already carries Sign_up_Proofc, Deposit_Proofc and Wager_Proof_\_c, plus the three \*\_Attached and \*\_Attached_Formula fields.

* Proof_Completion_Status__c exists and was renamed to Proof Status with emojis (2026-07-27).

* Proof URL fields are wired into the Log Sign Up flow rework (BUILD-43 / Doc #29+#42).

* Layout order changed so Proof Info sits above Referral Info (BUILD-23 / Doc #22).

Open Questions to update:

* Storage platform: GCP selected pending Wagertech technical sign-off. CONFIRM whether that sign-off has landed. Do not start the storage service until it has.

* Required proof set and completion weighting is the SAME blocker as BUILD-40 (Sign Up Completion %, Doc #26). Chase Wagertech once, unblock both.

Estimate impact: XL (\~54h) -> L (\~36h) for the remaining Proof Files object + upload component + storage service.

Update 2026-07-29: GCP confirmed by client 2026-07-20; implementation plan doc ready (POC 16h + 49h build) pending Kobi review then client send — client has chased twice. Go-live bridge delivered: proof URL fields + attached checkboxes work with Dropbox links today, GCP later, no rework. Storage build gated on client GCP prerequisites (service account, DWD, shared drive, file types/max size).
